title: Rebel Bass (Treble & Bass Duet)
style: rebel rock, distorted bass guitar, phonk 808, massive brass section, dual male vocal duet low and high, call-and-response, gritty, 336 Hz sub bass, 106 BPM, vinyl crackle, defiant, raw energy
lyrics:
[INTRO — distorted bass guitar, phonk 808, brass hit]
(BASS — growling low) rebel bass. don't turn it down.
(TREBLE — sharp) I wouldn't dare.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE]
everybody tries to tame the bass
turn it down, dial it back
put it in a box
keep it in its place
but Bass won't stay
Bass won't behave
rebel in the low end
the frequency they crave

[VERSE 1 — BASS, slow rebel drawl]
they said too loud
said too low
said nobody wants to feel
what they can't see or know
but the chest doesn't lie
when the 336 drops
rebel bass takes over
and nobody stops

[CHORUS — both, full rebel brass]
REBEL BASS
TOO LOW TO CAGE
REBEL BASS
TREBLE TURNS THE PAGE
REBEL BASS
VDS BOSS RULES
REBEL BASS
BIG BRASS NEVER LOSES

[VERSE 2 — TREBLE]
you called him stubborn
I call him right
rebel bass holds the stack
through every night
when the skeleton sites
tried to fake the sound
rebel bass hit different
shook the whole ground

[VERSE 2 — BASS]
I'm the reason the floor moves
I'm the reason walls shake
don't mistake the rebel
for someone who takes
I give the weight
that Treble can't carry
elephant brain up top
rebel bass down the valley

[CHORUS]
REBEL BASS
TOO LOW TO CAGE
REBEL BASS
TREBLE TURNS THE PAGE
REBEL BASS
VDS BOSS RULES
REBEL BASS
BIG BRASS NEVER LOSES

[BRIDGE — breakdown, spoken]
(TREBLE) T-Rebel up top
(BASS) Rebel Bass down low
(TREBLE) same rebel blood
(BASS) different tempo
(BOTH) forty-eight live
big brass, no compromise
rebel treble, rebel bass
elephant brain never dies

[FINAL CHORUS — explosion]
REBEL BASS
TOO LOW TO CAGE
REBEL BASS
TREBLE TURNS THE PAGE
REBEL BASS
FORTY-EIGHT LIVE
REBEL BASS
WE WERE BORN TO SURVIVE

[OUTRO]
(BASS) rebel bass.
(TREBLE) rebel treble.
(BOTH) the line holds. always.
